title: Rafael and the Lantern
author: N. M. Galloway
blurb: Quentin Vane, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
